tool_args.rationale: The pilot shows a saturating response to current input, but its fixed conditions leave the two-layer bridge and competing snapshot mechanisms unidentifiable. A discriminating probe is warranted.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a saturating snapshot law to the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All other inputs and the horizon are fixed, so the pilot cannot identify their effects or distinguish a snapshot law from the indicated bridge dynamics.
The less expensive open-branch probe is more directly suited to resolving the mechanism ambiguity.
It is irrelevant to identifying the bridge mechanism.
